title: Update on Shared Parental Leave take-up rate
asked: Whether an update can be provided on the take-up rate of the new Shared Parental Leave since 1 April 2025.
response: The take-up rate for the new Shared Parental Leave scheme is not yet available. The scheme started on 1 April 2025, and parents have up to a year after their child's birth to use the leave, with employers given an additional three months to submit claims. MSF will provide an update on the take-up rate for the 2025 birth cohort in mid-2027.
